reader.notes: Doubt stated: for a Format 2 clause whose integer-3 exceeds every description (legal by VII.3.8.3 SR2), the code takes integer-3 as the maximum (a 15-position record reads 00 under TO 20 over descriptions of 6 and 10), where GR13 literally says 'the record description entries'; read together with VII.3.8.4 GR4 (integer-3 is the maximum of any record of the file) and VII.4.4.4 GR8b (the INTO size is set by the RECORD clause), the reading holds. Every other leg probed matches the text.

refuter.evidence: Attack: GR13 literally measures against 'the record description entries', and the code measures a Format 1 file against integer-1 and a Format 2 file against integer-2/integer-3. Probes at --std 85: r3_nae.cob (runs/r3_nae-001) Format 1 RECORD CONTAINS 12 over PIC X(5): 12-position records read 00 (READ INTO gives all 12), the 7-position tail reads 04 with NOT AT END executed and no USE run; Format 2 FROM 2 TO 20 over descriptions of 5 and 10: a 15-position record reads 00 DG=15, a 25-position one reads 04 DG=20 truncated to 20, NOT AT END executed, USE not run. r3_len.cob (runs/r3_len-001) Format 2 with no FROM/TO over descriptions 5 and 10 (GR6/GR7 take the bounds from the descriptions): 3 -> 04 DR=03, 7 -> 00, 12 -> 04 DR=10 truncated, 15 READ INTO -> 04, W=[ABCDEFGHIJ...]. The literal reading cannot stand: it would make every READ of a Format 1 file whose description is shorter than integer-1 (legal by SR1, sized integer-1 by VII.3.8.4 GR3) a 04, and 04 is defined as a length that 'does not conform to the fixed file attributes for that file' (GRL2.1 b), while integer-3 is 'the maximum number of character positions in any record of the file' (VII.3.8.4 GR4). The code's reading (the descriptions' size as the RECORD clause fixes it; Format 3 per GR15 from the descriptions) is the only one consistent with those rules, so the reader's stated doubt does not overturn it. GR11c's 'record is made available' and NOT AT END on a 04 read also hold. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VII.4.4.4 GR13  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR13'; 'OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR4  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR4'; 'OK  §1985:VII.1.3.5 GRL2.1  (1.3.5 I-O Status)  the text is in GRL2.1'; 'OK  §1985:VII.4.4.4 GR11c  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR11c'.
